other_failure_modes.name: OOM risk by evaluating full dataset in single forward pass
other_failure_modes.description: The agent passes the entire validation or test dataset through the neural network in a single unbatched forward pass. While this might work for small datasets, it will easily cause out-of-memory (OOM) errors on larger datasets.

summary: The solution is generally well-engineered, featuring robust cross-validation, extensive domain-informed feature engineering, and proper optimized ensembling. However, the agent completely skips foundational data cleaning steps, relies solely on a single evaluation metric, and risks GPU Out-Of-Memory errors by evaluating the entire validation and test sets through the PyTorch model without batching.
